gap_rows.title: rwb-integration EFS hand-over contract: the activity contract, the consumed element shapes, the provided surface and the fakes have no source text
gap_rows.source: WP B-P2-01; legacy RWB-E2-001 section 12; RWB-P2-E2001-APP; RWB-P2-E2001-CON; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 16 (P2 IN: GET /interface-runs, POST /interface-runs/{id}/retry; OUT: FileDelivered, FileFailed); TSD P2 Integration v3 T-A.1; Ownership Map v1
gap_rows.description: The contract this slice needs does not exist in the source set. (1) The legacy story fixes a Java interface HandoverRun with one method returning a summary of read, created, linked, repeats, held and gap dates, and four in-process interfaces; nothing fixes a workflow name, activity names, inputs, outputs, a retry policy or a summary element list, so every one of them is a default of this story. (2) Architecture v5 slide 16 and TSD P2 v3 T-A.1 give rwb-integration only the interface-run operations and the outbound-file events; no source gives a hand-over operation, and the step is event-started, so the slice provides no REST operation at all. (3) The element names of the six consumed rwb-source-data operations, the rwb-case case-creation answer (created or linked, linked from, is primary) and the decision-record failure class are not in any source. (4) The error mapping from a failing owner answer to MSG-P1-001, MSG-P2-007, MSG-P7-003, MSG-P2-006, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-GEN-006 is implied by the legacy exception table and by the FSD exception flows, and is fixed here as a default. (5) MSG-P1-001 has two wordings; the FSD P2 Integration v3 wording is used and the legacy wording is not repaired.
gap_rows.evidence: Legacy RWB-E2-001 section 12 ('Published interface built (package recovery.integration.handover.api): public interface HandoverRun { HandoverSummary run(LocalDate businessDate); }') and the exception table MSG-P1-001, MSG-P2-007, MSG-P7-003, MSG-P2-006, MSG-P4-002. FSD P2 Integration v3 AC-EXC-P2-007-03, AC-EXC-P2-007-06, AC-EXC-P2-007-07 and VR-P2-001-1. Architecture v5 slide 16 (P2 contract, no hand-over path) and slide 44 (JOB-02 with rwb-case). TSD P2 Integration v3 T-A.1 API-P2-001 to API-P2-014 (no hand-over operation).
gap_rows.proposed: Fix the workflow, the nine activities, the twelve summary elements and the retry policy in contract/handover-run-activities.yaml; fix the six P1 elements and the P3 element in the two consumed contracts with the element names of this story as the default; carry the placeholder for every path and field name the source does not give; publish the six fakes from the owners' OpenAPI documents and fail the build on drift.

asm_rows.text: The rwb-integration service runs as one login created with the rwb_integration schema by the platform DB work (DP-02); the three stories of this key name it "the rwb-integration login" until the name is agreed, and carry it as a secret reference in the chart.
asm_rows.why: No source gives the login name and every DP-02 row requires one login per service; the legacy story ran on the shared recovery_svc login.
asm_rows.read: RWB-P2-E2001-APP sections 3, 10 and 13; RWB-P2-E2001-CON section 10; RWB-P2-E2001-OPS sections 10 and 11; DP-02 in Template and Rules section R5.5; Architecture v5 slide 41 (one schema and one login per service).
asm_rows.confirm: ACE DB owner and the platform DB story, before the rwb_integration baseline is created
asm_rows.impact: None on behaviour: the login is named by role and swapped for the agreed name without a content change.

asm_rows.text: MSG-P1-001 keeps the wording of FSD P2 Integration v3, "{product} is from {date}. Today's data is not yet complete.", and every other message keeps the legacy text of RWB-E2-001 unchanged.
asm_rows.why: The legacy story and the FSD carry two different texts for the same message id, and a message renderer can only hold one.
asm_rows.read: Legacy RWB-E2-001 section 14 ('{product} is from {date}. Today's load has not arrived.'); FSD P2 Integration v3 VR-P2-001-1 ('{product} is from {date}. Today's data is not yet complete.'); RWB-ITG-E2001-ITG section 14.
asm_rows.confirm: Error and Message Standard owner, before the message catalogue is frozen
asm_rows.impact: One alert and one screen text change; no behaviour changes.

asm_rows.text: The activity contract, the twelve HandoverSummary elements and the element names of the consumed rwb-source-data and rwb-case answers are fixed by RWB-P2-E2001-CON as the default for the build, and each owner confirms or corrects them at the contract review without changing the behaviour of the step.
asm_rows.why: No source declares a workflow, an activity, a summary element or an owner answer shape for this journey; the app story cannot be built or contract-tested without one agreed shape.
asm_rows.read: Legacy RWB-E2-001 section 12 (HandoverRun and the summary element list); RWB-P2-E2001-CON sections 11 and 12.5; Architecture v5 slide 11 (OpenAPI 3.1 contract-first, one hop); Template and Rules section R9.
asm_rows.confirm: Owners of RWB-P1-E1015-CON, RWB-P3-E2001-CON and RWB-PLT-E1027-CON at the contract review
asm_rows.impact: A renamed element touches one client, one activity and its fake; no business value changes.

asm_rows.text: This slice provides no REST operation of its own: the hand-over step is event-started and answers an activity, and the run is observed through the activity result, the run's local decision record and the REC-01 row of rwb-source-data.
asm_rows.why: Architecture v5 slide 16 and TSD P2 v3 T-A.1 give rwb-integration only the interface-run and outbox operations, no source gives a hand-over endpoint, and the Ownership Map publishes none; inventing a path would create an unowned resource, and the run is already observable without one.
asm_rows.read: Architecture v5 slide 16 (P2 IN: GET /interface-runs, POST /interface-runs/{id}/retry) and slide 44 (JOB-02 owner rwb-case); TSD P2 Integration v3 T-A.1 API-P2-001 to API-P2-014; Ownership Map v1 (GET /admin/scheduled-jobs owner P2; no hand-over path); RWB-ITG-E2001-ITG section 12.2.
asm_rows.confirm: Solution architect at the Service Contract Catalog review
asm_rows.impact: If an operator endpoint is required later, it is an additive change to the integration base with one new gap and no change to the step.
